quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'postpone' — to move an event to a later time.
quests.explanation: Postponed means delayed until another time, not cancelled completely. 'Because of heavy rain' explains a very common reason for postponing outdoor events.
quests.textToSpeak: The match was postponed because of heavy rain.
quests.textWithBlanks: The match was ___ because of heavy rain.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Having a duty to take care of someone or something.
quests.explanation: Responsible describes someone trusted to look after others or manage a task. Older siblings often feel this way naturally, even without being asked.
quests.textToSpeak: As the oldest child, she feels responsible for her younger brothers.
quests.textWithBlanks: As the oldest child, she feels ___ for her younger brothers.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: People who offer to help without being paid.
quests.explanation: Volunteers give their time freely to support a good cause. Beach clean-ups are a popular way for communities to help the environment.
quests.textToSpeak: Dozens of volunteers helped clean up the beach on Saturday.
quests.textWithBlanks: Dozens of ___ helped clean up the beach on Saturday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A disagreement, often between people who know each other well.
quests.explanation: An argument is a disagreement, sometimes serious and sometimes as minor as this one. 'Whose turn it was to cook' shows it was a small household matter.
quests.textToSpeak: They had a small argument about whose turn it was to cook.
quests.textWithBlanks: They had a small ___ about whose turn it was to cook.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The natural world around us, including the air, water, and land.
quests.explanation: Environment refers to the natural world we live in and depend on. 'Protect the environment' is one of the most common phrases on this topic.
quests.textToSpeak: Recycling paper and plastic helps protect the environment.
quests.textWithBlanks: Recycling paper and plastic helps protect the ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A chance to do something that could bring a good result.
quests.explanation: An opportunity is a favourable chance to achieve or gain something. 'Gave her a great opportunity' shows a positive result of a big life change.
quests.textToSpeak: Moving abroad gave her a great opportunity to learn a new language.
quests.textWithBlanks: Moving abroad gave her a great ___ to learn a new language.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: How someone responds, in words or expression, to something that happens.
quests.explanation: A reaction shows how someone feels about an event, often through their face or words. 'Priceless' means the reaction was wonderfully memorable.
quests.textToSpeak: His reaction to the surprise party was priceless.
quests.textWithBlanks: His ___ to the surprise party was priceless.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A connecting word used to introduce a surprising contrast.
quests.explanation: Although introduces a contrast between two ideas — rain would normally stop a walk, but it didn't here. It works much like 'even though.'
quests.textToSpeak: Although it was raining, they still went for a walk.
quests.textWithBlanks: ___ it was raining, they still went for a walk.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A plan for how much money you can spend.
quests.explanation: A budget sets a limit on spending for a project or event. 'Stick to your budget' is common financial advice.
quests.textToSpeak: We need to stick to our budget for the wedding.
quests.textWithBlanks: We need to stick to our ___ for the wedding.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Hurt or physically harmed, often during sport or an accident.
quests.explanation: Injured describes physical harm, a word you'll hear constantly in sports news. 'Second half' tells us exactly when it happened.
quests.textToSpeak: The player was injured during the second half of the match.
quests.textWithBlanks: The player was ___ during the second half of the match.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Making big improvements to a room or building, not just cleaning it.
quests.explanation: Renovating means significantly upgrading or repairing a space. 'This month' shows the project has a clear timeframe.
quests.textToSpeak: They're renovating their old kitchen this month.
quests.textWithBlanks: They're ___ their old kitchen this month.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Willing to change or adapt easily, not fixed or strict.
quests.explanation: Flexible describes someone or something that adapts easily. A flexible manager allows some freedom, like choosing your own start time.
quests.textToSpeak: My manager is quite flexible about what time we start work.
quests.textWithBlanks: My manager is quite ___ about what time we start work.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Feeling sure of your own abilities, without doubt or fear.
quests.explanation: Confident describes a strong belief in your own ability. 'Weeks of practising' explains exactly why her confidence grew.
quests.textToSpeak: She felt confident after weeks of practising her speech.
quests.textWithBlanks: She felt ___ after weeks of practising her speech.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'cancel' — to stop something from happening completely.
quests.explanation: Cancelled means an event will not happen at all, unlike 'postponed,' which means delayed. Storms are a common cause of flight cancellations.
quests.textToSpeak: The flight was cancelled due to the storm.
quests.textWithBlanks: The flight was ___ due to the storm.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Money given back to a customer, usually for a returned item.
quests.explanation: A refund returns your money, usually because something was faulty or unwanted. 'Full refund' means getting back the entire amount paid.
quests.textToSpeak: She asked for a full refund when the product broke.
quests.textWithBlanks: She asked for a full ___ when the product broke.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'struggle' — to find something difficult to do.
quests.explanation: Struggled describes real difficulty in doing something. 'At first' suggests things became easier for him later on.
quests.textToSpeak: He struggled to understand the instructions at first.
quests.textWithBlanks: He ___ to understand the instructions at first.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Able to do something well without wasting time or effort.
quests.explanation: Efficient describes something that works well without waste. 'Much more' sets up a clear comparison with what came before.
quests.textToSpeak: The new system is much more efficient than the old one.
quests.textWithBlanks: The new system is much more ___ than the old one.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The place someone is travelling to.
quests.explanation: A destination is the end point of a journey. 'Final' emphasises this was the last stop, not somewhere along the way.
quests.textToSpeak: Their final destination was a small village in the mountains.
quests.textWithBlanks: Their final ___ was a small village in the mountains.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'remind' — to help someone remember something.
quests.explanation: Reminded means helped someone recall information they might otherwise forget. Alarms are a very common tool used for this purpose.
quests.textToSpeak: The alarm reminded her that the meeting started in ten minutes.
quests.textWithBlanks: The alarm ___ her that the meeting started in ten minutes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Causing worry, pressure, or mental strain.
quests.explanation: Stressful describes situations that cause pressure or anxiety. Moving house is often listed as one of life's more stressful events.
quests.textToSpeak: Moving to a new city can be quite stressful.
quests.textWithBlanks: Moving to a new city can be quite ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A promise that something will be repaired or replaced if it breaks.
quests.explanation: A guarantee protects buyers if a product fails within a set time. 'Two-year' tells us exactly how long that promise lasts.
quests.textToSpeak: The washing machine comes with a two-year guarantee.
quests.textWithBlanks: The washing machine comes with a two-year ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'announce' — to make information known publicly.
quests.explanation: Announced means officially shared with the public. 'Ten new stores' shows this was significant business news.
quests.textToSpeak: The company announced its plans to open ten new stores.
quests.textWithBlanks: The company ___ its plans to open ten new stores.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Able to be trusted to work well every time.
quests.explanation: Reliable describes something that consistently works as expected. 'Slow but very reliable' shows that speed and dependability are two separate qualities.
quests.textToSpeak: Her old car is slow but very reliable.
quests.textWithBlanks: Her old car is slow but very ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Free to be used, seen, or spoken to.
quests.explanation: Available describes something or someone that is free or accessible right now. This is essential vocabulary for booking any appointment.
quests.textToSpeak: The doctor isn't available until next Thursday.
quests.textWithBlanks: The doctor isn't ___ until next Thursday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A person you work with, typically at the same company.
quests.explanation: A colleague is someone you work with — a little more formal than 'workmate.' 'Cover her shift' means temporarily taking over someone's work hours.
quests.textToSpeak: She asked a colleague to cover her shift on Friday.
quests.textWithBlanks: She asked a ___ to cover her shift on Friday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Making you extremely tired, more than just 'tiring.'
quests.explanation: Exhausting describes something that drains all your energy. Pairing it with 'but rewarding' shows two sides of the very same experience.
quests.textToSpeak: Caring for three young children is exhausting but rewarding.
quests.textWithBlanks: Caring for three young children is ___ but rewarding.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Arriving or doing things at the agreed or expected time.
quests.explanation: Punctual describes someone who is reliably on time. The second half of the sentence gives you a strong clue by showing exactly what that looks like.
quests.textToSpeak: He is always punctual — he has never once arrived late for a meeting.
quests.textWithBlanks: He is always ___ — he has never once arrived late for a meeting.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'install' — to put equipment or a program in place, ready to use.
quests.explanation: Installed means set up and ready to use, a word commonly used about software or equipment. 'Every computer in the office' shows the scale of the job.
quests.textToSpeak: The engineer installed new software on every computer in the office.
quests.textWithBlanks: The engineer ___ new software on every computer in the office.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The latest time or date by which something must be completed.
quests.explanation: A deadline is a firm time limit for finishing work. 'Just before' shows she finished with very little time to spare.
quests.textToSpeak: She finished the report just before the deadline.
quests.textWithBlanks: She finished the report just before the ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: People working together effectively to achieve a shared goal.
quests.explanation: Teamwork describes how well people cooperate toward a common goal. 'Finish the project early' shows a clear, positive result of good teamwork.
quests.textToSpeak: Good teamwork helped the group finish the project early.
quests.textWithBlanks: Good ___ helped the group finish the project early.
